intent: Verify whether employee Tobias Hartmann is the manager of store PowerTool Graz Jakomini and, if so, return his contact email.
success_criteria: Determine whether an employee named Tobias Hartmann is assigned to the PowerTool Graz Jakomini store with the store_manager role.
If he manages it, answer with <YES> and provide his employee_email, citing both his employee record_path and the store record_path.
If he does not manage it (no match, different store, or no manager role), answer with <NO> and do not expose an email; cite the matched store record_path.

args: WITH target_store AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, record_path AS store_path FROM stores WHERE store_name LIKE '%Graz Jakomini%') SELECT e.employee_id, e.record_path AS employee_path, e.employee_display_name, e.employee_email, e.job_title, e.store_id, ts.store_name, ts.store_path, CASE WHEN r.role_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_store_manager FROM target_store ts LEFT JOIN employee_accounts e ON e.store_id = ts.store_id AND e.employee_display_name = 'Tobias Hartmann' LEFT JOIN employee_role_assignments r ON r.employee_id = e.employee_id AND r.role_code = 'store_manager';

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Tobias Hartmann + PowerTool Graz Jakomini check: if is_store_manager=1 for the matched row → '<YES> Tobias Hartmann manages PowerTool Graz Jakomini ({store_name}). Contact email: {employee_email}.' Otherwise → '<NO> Tobias Hartmann does not manage PowerTool Graz Jakomini (no matching store_manager assignment found); no manager email provided.'
